text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser scores a brilliant 
victory against Twin Turbo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as they were talking about how 
amazing Twin Turbo was today and how her 
sheer determination to win shone through—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was Twin Turbo, in tears, sprinting 
in the exact opposite direction of the way 
back to the academy...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a series of events, they safely 
caught Twin Turbo, and the two headed home 
together on good terms.
